technical_jargon.text: Positive feedback in a climate model amplifies changes in solar radiation and ice cover. Albedo is a measure of reflected sunlight.
technical_jargon.note: The phrase 'positive feedback' is a climate-science term. VADER can treat the word 'positive' as praise; the manually labeled Albedo chunk shows this domain mismatch in the corpus evaluation.
